district.name: Chamarajanagar
district.description: Southern gateway of vast wildlife sanctuaries, Chamarajanagar is home to Bandipur Tiger Reserve, sacred Biligiri Rangana Hills (BR Hills), Male Mahadeshwara Hills (MM Hills), and scenic sunflower plains.
district.descriptionKannada: ವನ್ಯಜೀವಿ ಧಾಮಗಳ ತವರು ಚಾಮರಾಜನಗರ, ಬಂಡೀಪುರ ಹುಲಿ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಿತ ಪ್ರದೇಶ, ಬಿಳಿಗಿರಿ ರಂಗನ ಬೆಟ್ಟ, ಮಲೆ ಮಹದೇಶ್ವರ ಬೆಟ್ಟ ಮತ್ತು ಗುಂಡ್ಲುಪೇಟೆಯ ಸೂರ್ಯಕಾಂತಿ ಹೊಲಗಳಿಗೆ ಖ್ಯಾತವಾಗಿದೆ.

destinations.name: Bandipur National Park & Tiger Reserve
destinations.nameKannada: ಬಂಡೀಪುರ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಉದ್ಯಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಹುಲಿ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಿತ ಪ್ರದೇಶ
destinations.description: One of India's premier and most successful tiger reserves, spanning 874 sq km in the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve at the confluence of Western and Eastern Ghats. Shelters India's second highest wild tiger population along with large herds of Asian elephants, leopards, dholes (wild dogs), gaurs, and over 200 bird species.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Originally established in 1931 by the Maharaja of Mysore as Venugopala Wildlife Park; declared one of the first 9 Project Tiger reserves in India in 1973.
destinations.culturalImportance: A crown jewel of Indian wildlife conservation, famous for open jeep and canter safaris through scenic teak and rosewood forests.

photos.caption: Bandipur National Park & Tiger Reserve
photos.source: Karnataka Forest Department & Project Tiger India

destinations.bestSeason: October to May (Wildlife sightings optimal during dry season February to May)
destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 22 km from Gundlupet, 80 km from Mysuru, 220 km from Bengaluru
destinations.roadAccessibility: Situated right along National Highway 766 (Mysuru-Ooty highway; night traffic banned 21:00 to 06:00)
destinations.estimatedVisitDuration: Half day or overnight at Jungle Lodges
destinations.safetyInstructions: STRICT NIGHT TRAFFIC BAN on NH-766 through the forest between 21:00 and 06:00. Never step out of safari vehicles. Do not feed or tease wild animals.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Online safari booking via official Karnataka Forest Department portal or Jungle Lodges and Resorts
destinations.tourismInformationSource: Karnataka Forest Department & Project Tiger India

destinations.name: Biligiri Ranganatha Swamy Temple (BR Hills)
destinations.nameKannada: ಬಿಳಿಗಿರಿ ರಂಗನಾಥ ಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟ (ಬಿ ಆರ್ ಹಿಲ್ಸ್)
destinations.description: A unique ecological bridge connecting the Western and Eastern Ghats, rising 1,500 meters in a wildlife sanctuary teeming with tigers, elephants, and leopards. The white cliff summit ('Biligiri') is crowned by the sacred Biligiri Ranganatha Swamy Temple, worshipped by both mainstream pilgrims and the indigenous Soliga tribal community.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Sacred homeland of the Soliga indigenous forest dwellers; houses the sacred 2,000-year-old giant Champak tree (Dodda Sampige) deep in the forest.
destinations.culturalImportance: Unique harmony of tribal forest culture and Vedic temple traditions; offers misty jungle views and eco-tourism.
destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 28 km from Yelandur, 45 km from Chamarajanagar, 85 km from Mysuru
destinations.nearestRailwayStation: Chamarajanagar Railway Station (45 km) or Mysuru (85 km)
destinations.roadAccessibility: Paved ghat road winding through tiger reserve; forest checkpost regulates traffic
destinations.safetyInstructions: Drive slowly; wild elephants and gaurs frequently cross the ghat road. Forest road closed to traffic after 18:00.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Open temple entry; Jungle Lodges (K Gudi) organizes jeep safaris
